issue_title: [Bug] next_id 在并发环境下可能产生 ID 冲突（非原子 read-compute-write）

changes.summary: Fixed concurrent ID collision by implementing file locking (fcntl) for atomic add operations

implementation_details.approach: Used fcntl file locking to ensure atomic read-compute-write operations
key_changes: Implemented atomic_add() method using exclusive file locking
Added _ensure_unique_ids() helper method for ID collision detection and resolution
Updated TodoApp.add() to use atomic_add() for concurrent safety
risks: File locking uses fcntl which is Unix-specific (not available on Windows)
Lock file (.todo.json.lock) is created alongside the data file
